names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Νίκανδρος ο εν Αιγύπτου», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 15 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети мученик Никандар Мисирац.“, with the rank words Свети мученик left off. Мисирац is kept: it is not a rank but the epithet the heading gives him — Misir is Egypt — and it is what this folder's English name already carries.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 15 марта ст. ст., «Никандр Египтянин, врач, мч.», with the rank word left off. «врач», physician, is left off with it: it is the calling the life gives him and this folder already holds it in types, and the day's own line prints the forename alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 марта ст. ст. — «Мч. Никандра (ок. 302).»

attestations.note: The julian 15/3 agrees with the Serbian julian 15/3 this folder already carried. The line closes with «ок. 302» where the folder held 305 from saint.gr, so the death interval is now 302 to 305 and chooses neither. The life page behind the line calls him a physician, which this folder already carries in types, and dates the persecution to the reign of Diocletian, 284 to 305. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Νίκανδρος ο εν Αιγύπτου»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 305)», puts him under Diocletian, has him gather and bury the relics of martyrs and be arrested and tried in the year 305 at that work, and flayed and then burned with lighted torches by the tyrant's order. It prints no hymn. The corpus's Nicander of Egypt is one of ten martyrs whom the Romanian calendar keeps on 5 June, tormented with hunger, thirst and cold by the ruler of Egypt; that is another account and another day, and the two are kept apart.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.03.2026 (15. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Никандар Мисирац.“

attestations.note: The day's third and last entry, three sentences long, and the same man saint.gr keeps on this day: the charge against him was that as a physician he helped the Christian martyrs and buried the bodies of the executed honourably, and he was flayed and then beheaded. The Prologue dates his passion 302, where this folder holds 305 from saint.gr; the sourced year is left standing and the disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved. `physician` is added to `types` from the entry's own word — it calls him лекар, a physician, which is BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5's mapping and is also what saint.gr's life makes him. The stored form keeps Мисирац, which is not a rank but the epithet the heading itself gives him, the Egyptian, and it is what this folder's English name already carries. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The two calendars disagree and the interval holds both. saint.gr puts the execution of this work in 305: «Στην εκτέλεση του ιερού αυτού έργου, το έτος 305 μ.Χ.». days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 15 марта ст. ст. with «(ок. 302)» and ends its life page «а затем обезглавили (+ ок. 302)», and dates the persecution to the reign of Diocletian, 284 to 305. Nothing is chosen.
